central brass latch on front edge
wooden material with brown color and visible grain
flat base for stable standing

detail.issues: Model A has simplified and less detailed carvings, a less accurate latch shape, and a different wood tone. Model B has simplified carvings, a less accurate latch shape, and a darker wood tone.
Model A lacks the clip and has a simplified nib; Model B has incorrect clip shape, missing clip, and wrong nib details.

features.feature: long rectangular seat
two stone legs
rough, natural stone texture on seat and legs
distinctive brownish streaks on right leg
slightly uneven edges on seat

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect textures with artificial patterns and color mismatches, while Model B lacks the natural stone appearance and detailed texture of the reference, featuring overly smooth surfaces and simplified geometry.
Model A has less accurate color and texture details compared to Model B, which is closer to the reference in color and surface texture.
Model A has incorrect flower details and color tone; Model B has less accurate floral patterns and color matching compared to the reference.

Model A has color mismatches (darker tones) and minor geometric distortions in handle and base; Model B is closer but still has subtle color variations and minor shape differences in the handle and base compared to the reference.
